sumInsured: As per Policy Schedule (not provided in extract)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: The Company agrees to automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year
great.explanation: Automatically reinstates up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in the same policy year. This can protect you from running out of cover after multiple hospitalizations.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness except for claim under Any one Illness condition.
great.explanation: The recharged amount can be used even for the same illness, except where the 'Any one Illness' condition applies. This is stronger than restores that work only for unrelated illnesses.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: For any single Claim during a Policy Year, the maximum Claim amount payable shall be sum total of Sum Insured, Cumulative Bonus, Inflation Shield.
great.reference: Clause 3, General Conditions Applicable To All The Benefits, point 2(II)
great.explanation: For a single claim, the maximum payable can be the total of Sum Insured, Cumulative Bonus and Inflation Shield. This increases the available payout beyond just the base Sum Insured.

great.name: No Claim Bonus
great.quote: enhance the Sum Insured by 50% flat, on a cumulative basis... provided that no Claim has been paid... or total claim amount payable does not exceed the 25% of the base Sum Insured
great.reference: Clause 3.1.11 Benefit : No Claim Bonus Protect
great.explanation: Sum Insured can be enhanced by 50% flat on a cumulative basis if no claim is paid, or if total claim amount payable does not exceed 25% of the base Sum Insured. This can grow your coverage meaningfully over claim-light years.

great.name: NCB
great.quote: In the event of total claim amount payable exceeds 25% of the base Sum Insured during any Policy Year, the accrued Cumulative Bonus will be reduced at same rate at which it is accrued
great.explanation: If total claim amount payable exceeds 25% of the base Sum Insured in a policy year, the accrued Cumulative Bonus is reduced at the same rate at which it was accrued. This is better than policies that reset the bonus to zero after a claim.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from the inception of the first policy with the insurer. You should plan for out-of-pocket costs for PED treatment during this waiting period.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting Period
good.quote: shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Specified illnesses are excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage. Claims for listed conditions in the first 2 years may be rejected even if they are not pre-existing.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illness treatment is excluded for the first 30 days from policy commencement, except for accidents. Non-accident hospitalizations in the first month are typically not payable.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Under Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 60 days immediately prior
good.explanation: Covers pre-hospitalization medical expenses for 60 days immediately prior to hospitalization. This helps pay for tests and consultations leading up to admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Under Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses, for a period of 90 days immediately after
good.explanation: Covers post-hospitalization medical expenses for 90 days immediately after discharge. This supports follow-up treatment and medicines after hospitalization.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: If the Policy Schedule states ‘up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day’ as eligible Room Rent, it means the maximum eligible Room Rent... is limited to 1% of the Sum Insured per day of Hospitalization.
bad.explanation: Room rent can be capped at 1% of the Sum Insured per day if stated in the Policy Schedule. Choosing a higher room can trigger large out-of-pocket costs and proportionate deductions on the whole bill.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: The Policyholder/Insured Person shall bear the ratable proportion of the total Associate Medical Expenses... in the proportion of the difference between the Room Rent actually incurred and the Room Rent specified in the Policy Schedule
bad.explanation: If you take a room above the eligible room rent, you must bear expenses in proportion to the difference between actual room rent and eligible room rent. This can reduce payouts across associated hospital charges, not just the room rent.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – I to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.explanation: Items listed as non-medical in Annexure I (e.g., gloves, masks) are excluded. You may have to pay these common hospital consumables from your pocket during a claim.

bad.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
bad.quote: Any Medical Expenses incurred for the treatment in relation to any of the following diseases shall not be payable under this Benefit : ... Diabetes Mellitus... Hypertension... Arthritis...
bad.explanation: Domiciliary hospitalization does not pay for home-treatment expenses related to listed diseases such as Diabetes Mellitus, Hypertension and Arthritis. This significantly limits the usefulness of domiciliary cover for common chronic conditions.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: For diseases or conditions or procedure that have a specified sub-limit then all related expenses shall be covered up to the sub-limit specified for that disease or condition or procedure.
bad.explanation: Where a disease/condition/procedure has a specified sub-limit, all related expenses are covered only up to that sub-limit. This can leave you with a large shortfall even when your Sum Insured is higher.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The Co-payment proportion (if applicable)... The Policy Schedule will specify the Optional Benefits that are in force
bad.explanation: A co-payment proportion may apply as per the Policy Schedule/optional benefits in force. If applicable, you will have to pay a fixed percentage of each admissible claim yourself.
